newsitem.title: USA: Conceptus says founder Nikolchev resigns.
newsitem.headline: Conceptus says founder Nikolchev resigns.

text.p: Conceptus Inc on Thursday said company founder and vice president of research and development Julian Nikolchev has resigned.
He will continue to consult with the company.
Steven Bacich, a co-founder of Imagyn Medical Inc and 14-year veteran of the medical device industry, will replace Nikolchev as vice president of research and development.
Bacich had served as Imagyn's director of new product Development, where he developed several new technologies in women's health, Conceptus said.
